##### Project General Facts

Valia, a residential masterpiece by Emaar Properties, rises as a sleek, sculptural silhouette, effortlessly defining the contemporary high-rise landscape with its refined verticality, rhythmic vertical fins, and precise horizontal detailing. The tower's facade, a breathtaking expanse of full-height glazing, reflects the sky and light, while floor-to-ceiling windows in each residence draw in daylight and frame panoramic views of the surrounding waterfront, boulevard, and skyline. This architectural gem is crowned by a discreet illuminated feature, imparting a distinctive night-time signature that sets Valia apart. The residence collection encompasses a thoughtfully proportioned range of one-, two-, three-, and four-bedroom apartments, each designed to maximize the tower's uninterrupted horizons.

Residents of Valia are treated to a comprehensive amenity program, centered on a stunning, resort-style, temperature-controlled swimming pool, beautifully framed by generous sun-lounging decks, shaded poolside cabanas, and elegant seating pavilions. A dedicated kids' pool, landscaped sun deck, and modern changing facilities further enhance the experience, while a state-of-the-art fitness centre, equipped with premium cardio and strength-training equipment, is perfectly positioned to enjoy natural light and open views. The amenity level also features landscaped gardens, a residents' lounge, and communal social spaces, all designed to foster a genuine sense of community within the building.

The interiors of Valia boast modern finishing with high-quality materials, creating elegant and comfortable living spaces that embody sophistication and functionality. With spacious layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows, and carefully selected finishes, every residence is a masterclass in refined contemporary design, emphasizing openness, light, and functionality. The attention to detail and commitment to quality are evident in every aspect of Valia, from the meticulously crafted residences to the beautifully landscaped gardens and pedestrian-friendly walkways, creating a truly exceptional living experience.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Creek Harbour, the location of Valia, is the heart of a bold new vision for Dubai, a visionary eight square kilometre waterfront destination that is redefining the frontiers of architecture, design, and quality of life. Creek Beach, a first-of-its-kind urban beach, offers a unique family-friendly retreat, complete with seven hundred metres of pristine white sands, an infinity pool, and spectacular sunset views. The iconic Dubai Creek Tower, designed by the renowned architect Santiago Calatrava, is set to surpass the Burj Khalifa as the tallest structure globally, serving as a symbol of Dubai's ambition and innovation.

Dubai Creek Harbour represents a bold vision for the future, blending cutting-edge design, sustainability, and cultural richness to create a dynamic and iconic waterfront destination. This vibrant location is a testament to Dubai's commitment to innovation and its ambition to create world-class living spaces. With its stunning natural beauty, rich cultural heritage, and unparalleled amenities, Dubai Creek Harbour is the perfect location for those seeking a unique and unforgettable living experience.

The surroundings of Dubai Creek Harbour are a treasure trove of excitement and discovery, with the historic Dubai Creek, Creek Beach, and the iconic Dubai Creek Tower, all coming together to create a truly unforgettable experience. The area is a hub of activity, with a wide range of amenities and attractions, from pristine beaches to world-class dining and entertainment options, making it the perfect location for families, professionals, and everyone in between. With its unique blend of traditional charm and modern sophistication, Dubai Creek Harbour is a location that has something for everyone.
